issues.claim: Handle errors in ASP.NET Core controller-based web APIs
issues.problem: The fetched page redirects to a different URL and is titled 'Handle errors in ASP.NET Core APIs'. It now covers Minimal APIs and controllers, so the 'controller-based' title in both locales does not match it.
issues.suggestedFix: EN: 'Handle errors in ASP.NET Core APIs'. RU: 'Обработка ошибок в API ASP.NET Core'. Consider updating the URL to the canonical https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/fundamentals/error-handling-api.

issues.problem: RFC 9457 says consumers SHOULD ignore unrecognized extensions. The 'обязаны' here is a company rule, not the RFC's wording, and the answer does not make that distinction clear.
issues.suggestedFix: Word it as a rule for the company's clients, for example 'В контракте компании клиенты должны игнорировать неизвестные поля-расширения (RFC: SHOULD ignore)'. Mirror the change in EN.

issues.claim: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/best-practices/api-design, cited for event versioning, additive-only changes and a deprecation window for webhook contracts
issues.problem: The excerpt covers general RESTful API design: URIs, statelessness and hypermedia. It shows nothing about webhooks, event contracts, at-least-once delivery, retries or signatures. Its versioning section covers request/response API versioning, so it supports the 'evolution over years' point at best only loosely. The generator flagged this same doubt.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace it with a source that supports the retry and isolation claims, such as the Azure Architecture Center Retry pattern and Circuit Breaker pattern pages. Alternatively keep it only for versioning and add a second source, such as the Microsoft REST API guidelines (https://github.com/microsoft/api-guidelines). Update linkTitles in both locales to match.

issues.claim: Standard Webhooks headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature; HMAC-SHA256 over id, timestamp and body; multiple signatures during secret rotation; timestamp tolerance
issues.problem: The excerpt is only the repository README. It shows that reference libraries exist in many languages, including C#, but not the spec text for the header names, the signed content, rotation or timestamp checks. These claims match my knowledge of spec/standard-webhooks.md, but the excerpt does not confirm them.
issues.suggestedFix: Point the link at the spec file (https://github.com/standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks/blob/main/spec/standard-webhooks.md), or keep the repository URL if the reviewer confirms the spec text.
